theorems.statement: ∀ (m d P : ℕ) (B B' : Set (Euclid d)) (G : Euclid d → Euclid P) (J h : Euclid d → ℝ) (g : Euclid P → ℝ), MeasurableSet B → MeasurableSet B' → B' ⊆ B → ContinuousOn G B → InjOn G B → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ w in G '' B, f w ∂μHE[m] = ∫ v in B, J v * f (G v) ∂μHE[m]) → (∀ᵐ v ∂(μHE[m].restrict B), h v = B'.indicator (fun y => J y * g (G y)) v) → ∫ v in B, h v ∂μHE[m] = ∫ w in G '' B', g w ∂μHE[m]
